title: Sample width
detail: Table 2 lists the large samples as 41 cm wide. The paper's text and the Figure 10 legend say 40 cm. 1gnition shows the table value and this note.

title: Duct height
detail: The duct height described in Section II of the paper does not match Table 2. The table value is shown until the team confirms which is right.

title: Single read
detail: IV-1 and V-2 were read from the table once. The other four runs were checked twice.

title: Nominal conditions
detail: The comparison uses Table 2 settings. The team audit found differences between nominal values and PSI flight records. Treat an airflow-only contrast as exploratory.
